title: DocAtlas：将长文档理解视为可变状态交互
summary: DocAtlas 将长文档理解建模为可变状态的信息寻求过程，通过外部文档环境提供搜索、阅读、笔记和回顾工具，维护层级树和笔记存储，在固定上下文预算下结合自改进检索、选择性证据访问和主动工作记忆。支持大型 VLM 推理和紧凑 VLM 的端到端强化学习，在 MMLongBench-Doc 上超越人类专家水平。
summary_en: DocAtlas models long-document understanding as mutable-state interaction, using an external document harness with search, reading, note-taking, and review tools. It combines self-improving retrieval and active memory under a fixed context budget, achieving 71.4% on MMLongBench-Doc with GPT-5.4 and 63.7% with a compact VLM trained via RL.
